css-view-transitions.verdict: REFUSED — requires-view-transitions stays SCORED, added to REFUSED_EXCLUSION_TAGS
css-view-transitions.wall: REAL. ::view-transition / -group / -image-pair / -old / -new are UA-generated top-layer boxes holding snapshot images. They are not in the DOM, so neither the static extractor nor post-load-extract.mjs (which walks real elements for computed styles) can ever serialize them. 178 of 195 tests DID bake post-load and it changed nothing about the pseudo tree.
css-view-transitions.whyRefusedAnyway: The wall is not separable from an accidentally-deliverable subset. A transition frozen at .ready shows the OLD snapshot, which IS the pre-script DOM.
css-view-transitions.barToBeat: the accepted families sit at 1.000 (Rule 42 browser-ref-divergent, Rule 15 font-face) or an effective ~1.0 (Rule 40 anchor: 0.89 raw, but its post-load stamp re-admitted 78 of 87)
css-view-transitions.closingMove: a view-transition CAPTURE mode — drive the transition in the ref browser and serialize the settled pseudo tree as ordinary boxes — not an exclusion

css-page.verdict: REFUSED — @page canvas simulation is NOT bounded; requires-print-medium stays SCORED (wave-36 M6 decision re-confirmed from the other direction)
css-page.decisiveFact: capture-browser-ref.mjs never calls emulateMediaType('print'), so every ref is a SCREEN-medium render. All 157 css-page ref PNGs are 390 px wide (CANVAS_WIDTH) no matter what @page size the test declares; ref HEIGHT varies (600…2304) because a screen render is one continuous flow. The refs instead hand-encode the expected PAGED result as ordinary DOM at that width.
css-page.largestBoundedSubMechanism: the 12 margin-boxes/* cells needing ONLY the CSS Paged Media §5.3 sixteen-box margin grid — still a feature (the auto/percentage dimension algorithm), not a canvas tweak
css-page.note: the 8 failures no signal claimed were hand-read and are paged too: subpixel-page-size-* (page overflow), page-margin-negative*/auto-negative* (negative page margins), safe-printable-inset-* (page-margin-safety), media-queries-003 (<frameset> + print MQ)

The refusals themselves are enforced by the negative pins in tools/titan/inject-wpt-block.test.mjs.
